prompt: Create a photorealistic quiet everyday indoor portrait of a new independent fictional East Asian woman, exactly 21 years old and clearly adult. Vertical 2:3 composition from a little space above her messy bun to her mid-thighs. She leans her upper back and head lightly against a cream-colored doorway at frame left, torso angled diagonally toward frame right, with her near shoulder gently lifted and her face turned back over it. Her eyes look downward toward frame left, her lips softly parted, expression sleepy and thoughtful without a smile. Give her distinct adult features: softly rounded oval face, delicate but mature cheekbones, gently tapered chin, a small straight nose and relaxed almond eyelids. Dark hair is gathered into a loose high messy bun, with irregular wisps at the crown and several curved strands falling across the forehead, cheek and neck. Her adult frame is petite and light, shoulders moderately narrow and relaxed, ribcage proportionate, natural adult head-to-shoulder ratio. Preserve the gentle full covered bust-to-waist contour without exaggeration, broad shoulders or an artificially tiny waist. She wears an opaque gray-beige fine ribbed fitted sleeveless camisole with narrow straps, a modest neckline and a hem reaching the waist. Preserve the vertical knit texture, natural small wrinkles and everyday cotton feel. She wears loose short gray-and-white checkered lounge shorts with a softly rumpled hem. An oversized gray sweatshirt or light jacket has slipped from the shoulders and is loosely gathered around the forearms, creating substantial soft folds in the lower-left foreground. One relaxed hand emerges below a broad ribbed cuff near the lower center, fingers gently curled downward. Keep the natural support of the leaning pose and anatomically coherent shoulder, elbow, wrist and fingers. The near arm slopes downward along the body; do not invent raised arms or other gestures. The cream door jamb occupies a broad vertical strip at frame left, with a small diagonal handle or rail at lower left. At frame right, a pale cream metal-framed glass door provides thin vertical and horizontal lines and a rectangular handle. Behind her is a softly blurred grid of small muted teal-green tiles above a dark warm-brown wooden lower panel, with a small green plant glimpse near the lower left. Soft diffused daylight from frame left creates warm gentle skin highlights and subdued shadows, with muted beige, gray and teal colors and an intimate lived-in atmosphere. Preserve the off-center leaning composition, high bun, downward glance, knit top, checkered shorts and draped gray garment as separate visual elements. Light retouching, fine skin microtexture, subtle photographic grain and softly subdued contrast, no cold-white skin or glossy studio finish. Reorganize only the outer edge space for vertical 2:3, keeping the bun, face and visible hand inside the frame without stretching or enlarging. Full standing height, feet and frontal full-body view remain outside this crop. No readable text, social-media overlays, logos, usernames, watermark, border, nudity or explicit sexual content. Generate the image now.
